gloss: to heal; to soothe; to comfort

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {癒|いや}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: To restore health, to cure an illness or injury. Can refer to physical healing.

definitions.gloss: to soothe; to comfort; to refresh
definitions.explanation: To ease emotional pain, tiredness, or stress. Very common in modern Japanese in the context of relaxation and emotional comfort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}した。
examples.english: I soaked in a hot spring and healed my body's fatigue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}して⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Time will probably heal the wounds of the heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{癒|いや}される。
⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}して⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The presence of a pet soothes the weariness of daily life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ことで、⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{癒|いや}される⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By spending time in nature, you can have an experience that soothes both body and mind.

notes:
USAGE:
A godan verb ({五段活用|ごだんかつよう}: {癒|いや}さない、{癒|いや}します、{癒|いや}す、{癒|いや}せば、{癒|いや}そう). Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what is being healed. The passive form {癒|いや}される is extremely common, meaning "to be soothed/comforted by."

RELATED WORDS:
The noun form ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧ (healing, comfort) is widely used in modern Japanese: ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧ (healing space), ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (soothing type, used for people or things that are comforting). The concept of ⟦{癒|いや}し→癒し：13604_iyashi⟧ has become a cultural keyword in Japan, associated with stress relief and relaxation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}す: to heal a wound
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}す: to soothe tiredness
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{癒|いや}す: to soothe the heart
- {癒|いや}される: to be comforted/soothed (by something)
